messages.subject: Beginner question on Surg Tutorial
parts:
Hi all,
firstly I would say that I am totally new to Bayesian modelling. For my project I'll work on compositional data, but before tackling my own problem from zero, I am studying the tutorials.

In the Surg tutorial, we model the numbers of death, conditional to the latent variable p_i, as r_i ~ Binomial(p_i, n_i) where p_i are the failure probabilities and p_i~Beta(0.001,0.001).
So the code

formula = r ~ f(hospital,model="iid",param=c(0.001,0.001))
mod.surg = inla(formula,data=Surg,family="binomial",Ntrials=n)

the number of death is modeled as a fixed effect (the intecept) and a random effect between hospitals. Am I correct? And where in the hospital I specify the Beta distribution as a prior?
